title: Severe bleeding
tldr: Call emergency services and press firmly directly on the bleeding wound with a dressing or clean cloth. Maintain pressure. For life-threatening bleeding from an arm or leg, use a commercial tourniquet if trained; follow dispatcher instructions.
steps: Check scene safety, use gloves if available and get emergency help.
Press firmly over the wound and keep pressing until bleeding stops or appropriate help takes over.
Use a tourniquet or wound packing for the appropriate injury if trained, following the device and dispatcher instructions.
Keep them from getting cold, check breathing and remain until responders arrive.
next: Get urgent medical assessment even if bleeding stops. Take a practical bleeding-control course.
